long_biography.plain_text:
Brandart began in Busto Arsizio around 2000 with a business model that combined design, sourcing, production management and logistics for premium brands. Under Sedgh's ownership, it expanded from luxury-accessory packaging into eyewear, retail displays, international offices and sustainable material development.

The company remained wholly owned by Maurizio Sedgh in 2019, when revenue passed €100 million. Four years later Tikehau Capital purchased a 25% minority holding, leaving him in control while providing capital for expansion. Sedgh subsequently became president as operational leadership passed to Massimo Paloni. Brandart has since broadened its capabilities through acquisitions spanning retail interiors, boutique displays, mechatronics and architectural lighting. Outside the business, Sedgh joined the board of Italy's Cystic Fibrosis Research Foundation.
